messages:
dara: heads-up - new int8 canary (zephyr2) surfaces a weird nested-escape loop where args become double-escaped strings, especially on non-latin scripts. noticed after the latest PTQ seed change.
canary-bot: canary=zephyr2-int8 subset=multilingual parse_failure_rate=2.1% -> 7.8% (24h)
mike: examples from logs (raw emits):
```
{"tool":"upload","args":"{\"path\":\"/tmp/notes.txt\",\"content\":\"概要:　テスト\"}"}
{"tool":"upload","args":"\'{\\\"path\\\":\\\"/tmp/esp.txt\\\",\\\"content\\\":\\\"Resumen:…\\\"}\'"}
{"herramienta":"subir","argumentos":"{\"ruta\":\"/tmp/x\",\"contenido\":\"Resumen\"}"}
```
mike: parser sees args as a single string with escaped JSON and sometimes wrapped in single quotes. fails to unescape reliably and then retry hits latency SLO.
hana: interesting pattern: fp16 rarely produces the double-escape; int8 increases probability when content includes ideographs or punctuation clusters.
dara: hypothesis: quantization changed tokenization near multi-byte char boundaries, causing model to emit backslashes more often as escape tokens. also some localization of key names.
vik: short-term mitigation: implement an "unescape cascade" in postproc: 1) normalize smart/single quotes, 2) if args is string try iterative unescape up to N times, 3) detect localized key names via small alias map. cheap CPU.
sara: do we have metrics for how often iterative unescape recovers valid JSON?
mike: ran a 3k-sample local probe: iterative unescape recovered ~72% of the nested-string cases, with false-positive ~0.8% where we accidentally flattened intended string values.
hana: false-positive risk matters because we might alter legitimate string payloads. need a conservative detector: only unescape if top-level string looks like an escaped object (starts with '{' after strip and contains ":).
dara: also need locale-aware alias map. mike, can you add common translations for tool/args like herramienta/herramientos/etc?
mike: will add ~12 entries.
vik: longer-term: ask quant team for a PTQ run with "escape-preserve" training objective or different seed. also test int8+vocab-remap where we force ascii quotes to be tokenized as single tokens.
sara: add an ablation: fp16 baseline, int8 default, int8+postproc, int8+vocab-remap. run on en/ja/es 5k each. record parse_accept, repair_rate, misrepair_rate, p50/p95 latency.
hana: I'll schedule the sweep and wire the metrics to canary dashboard. owner: hana.
dara: if postproc recovers >85% with misrepair <=1% we can enable for canary; else keep those locales pinned to fp16 until quant fix.
mike: implementing conservative unescape and alias-map now. will share small diff for review.
vik: also add logging tag when we run iterative unescape so we can inspect edge cases later.
sara: good. also consider lightweight classifier to detect nested-escape patterns before parsing to avoid running unnecessary unescape. cheap heuristics should work.
hana: thanks team. will post initial sweep numbers tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
